<thought>Using the mapped reaction from template 1914395, the retrosynthetic transformation replaces a fluorine attached to a carbon in a heterocycle with a hydroxyl group. Applying this to the target molecule yields a single precursor where the fluorine is substituted by an oxygen. The resulting precursor SMILES is "OC1CN(Cc2ccc(CCl)cc2)C1". Therefore the list of possible precursors is a list containing this single SMILES string.</thought>
